summary: The aggregation window is the calendar month.
A cash transaction is one with CoreOne transaction type 'C'.
Only Branch Teller and Cash Deposit Machine channels count as cash.
Cash deposits through Cash Deposit Machines are in scope.
ATM cash withdrawals are excluded.
Connected transactions are grouped per customer across all of that customer's accounts.
Customers are identified by the UCIC.
Debits and credits are aggregated separately, each tested against the threshold.
Transactions below INR 50,000 inside a reportable series are not listed.
Transfers between the bank's own internal accounts are excluded.
The conversion uses the Treasury card rate of the transaction date.
Walk-in customers' cash transactions are grouped by the PAN on the voucher.
The nature of a transaction is expressed as deposit or withdrawal.
Each reported transaction carries account number, customer name and branch code.
Transaction attributes come from CoreOne TXN_HIST.
Customer name comes from CUST_MASTER, joined on UCIC.
The report uses FIU-IND's account-based XML format.
Reports must pass FIU-IND's validation utility before submission.
A draft is produced by the 5th working day for the Principal Officer's review.
Errors found after submission are corrected with a replacement report.
'the parties to the transaction' (R4) is not defined and the BRD never pins it down: Account holder only, or also a third party who deposits the cash.
'UCIC for each account' is needed by A08, A09, A20 but no mapping provides it.
'debit/credit indicator' is needed by A10, A17 but no mapping provides it.
'internal account flag' is needed by A12 but no mapping provides it.
'Treasury card rate by date' is needed by A14 but no mapping provides it.
'PAN on voucher' is needed by A15 but no mapping provides it.
'branch code' is needed by A18 but no mapping provides it.
